recipes.name: Grilled Chicken with Rosemary and Bacon

steps.text: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat, and lightly oil the grate.

Sprinkle 1 teaspoon garlic powder on each chicken breast and season with salt and pepper. Lay one rosemary sprig on each chicken breast. Wrap bacon around the chicken to hold the rosemary on. Secure bacon with a toothpick or an additional thick rosemary stem.

Cook chicken breasts until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 8 minutes per side. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C). Stay near the grill to combat any flare-ups from the bacon. Remove the toothpicks before serving.

raw_recipe.headline: Grilled Chicken with Rosemary and Bacon
raw_recipe.description: A sprig of rosemary adds wonderful flavor and aroma to this quick and easy recipe for grilled chicken wrapped in bacon. A delicious and simple, yet elegant presentation.

review.reviewBody: This is a great summer recipe - quick, fresh tasting and delicious too! I used thin chicken breasts so that the bacon and rosemary didn't get overdone. The rosemary flavor is very subtle, with the bacon flavor being stronger. It is an elegant dish that would be impressive for guests, but is simple enough to enjoy on a busy weeknight as well.

Very easy to make and tasty too! Rubbed with sea salt, minced garlic and pepper mixture and placed on a cookie sheet rubbed with olive oil. ( I had to cook in the oven since we do not have a grill at this time. ) Baked it at 425 degrees 8 minutes on each side. Served with wild rice and roasted brussel sprouts.

I enjoy the flavor of rosemary so I thought I'd give this a try. I had some costco bacon in the freezer which I got out at 4:00 pm for a 6:30 dinner. The bacon defrosted easy enough and the only change I did was to use fresh garlic as I don't like the flavor of dried. Just chopped it up then added a pinch of kosher salt and smashed it into a garlic paste. Put that on the chicken following the rest of the instructions. Okay, I did use a blow torch to crisp up the parts of the bacon that the grill didn't get to, but I like my bacon crispy and it was great. This is a keeper

These turned out beautifully!!! So delicious!!! I stuffed them with goat cheese and baked them in the oven uncovered in a 300° oven for 1 hour. Then baked them at 350° for 20 minutes to let the bacon get crispy. My family loved these!!! I made nappa cabbage as a side dish. Super yummy!!!

The fam loved this chicken! Will use less garlic powder next time, as it was a bit much for me. I made one addition by spreading some herb goat cheese directly on top of the chicken before the rosemary, then rolled up the chicken and wrapped the bacon around it - fabulous!

Always put lemon juice over my chicken wrapped in bacon then sprinkle it with the rosemary. I also like to rub my chicken pieces in Olive oil after seasoning. And the smaller the chicken bites wrapped in bacon, the better to my family! I've been making this for years and I was curious if other people knew this recipe. Family favorite

I loved this recipe and it was so easy to make. I will say it took 3-4 pieces of bacon to wrap each breast, but the more bacon the merrier. I also used two rosemary sprigs per breast, one on the top and one on the bottom. Didn't feel like firing up the grill so opted for the cast iron skillet instead. Worked wonderfully.
Substituted Curry for the Rosemary and baked it instead of frying it. Delish!

This was a big hit although I modified it quite a bit. I used chicken tenders which I marinated for a couple of hours in olive oil and lime juice, rosemary, garlic powder, salt and lemon pepper. I wrapped in prosciutto. Grilled and put a piece of mozzarella on top at the end. I served for company and everyone raved. Next time - and there will be a next time - I'll use goat cheese or something a bit more flavorful.
This was fabulous. I pounded the chicken and it made it easier to wrap the bacon. I used dried rosemary instead of the sprigs and stuffed the chicken with cojack. The company raved about it.

Great Recipe. Delicious. I halved the breasts and pounded them out. I used garlic salt with parsley and pepper (sparingly as this can be really strong). Stuffed each one with poly-o String cheese. I am not a super fan of rosemary so i used 3-4 individual leaves, wrapped in regular cut bacon. This was super easy. Next i will stuff with stove top stuffing, then feta and spinach, etc etc. so many ways to do this recipe.
Yum!!
Awesome
So good! Adding this to my recipe book! A great recipe to impress friends
Absolutely loved this recipe! It turned out perfect definitely saving it for next time.
Excellent
My family loved it! The only thing I changed is I only had Rosemary in my shaker and it worked perfectly!
Rosemary isn’t needed really, kinda more of a preference. But all in all it’s a great summer meal. Super easy to make and super easy to cook.
Pretty good, but the bacon grease caught my grill on fire.
This is a really simple and good recipe will definitely do this again
